map.水胶比越小强度越高吗？: Does a lower water-binder ratio always mean higher strength?

map.碎石表面粗糙需更多砂浆包裹，砂率与用水量略高；卵石和易性好但界面粘结稍弱，需按骨: Crushed stone has a rough surface and needs more mortar to coat it, so the sand ratio and water content are slightly higher. Rounded gravel gives better workability but weaker interfacial bond, so adjust for the aggregate type.
